result:
Thanks for pasting the spreadsheet. That tells me a lot about how it works today: one row per loan, with seed, packets, borrower, and dates out and back.

One thing stood out. About a third of the "Date back" cells are empty. With a seed library, that could mean several different things. Seeds might still be out, they might have come back without anyone noting it, or they might never have been expected back as packets at all. Each of those points to a different fix, so I'd rather not guess which one is behind it.

So before I suggest anything: **when the current spreadsheet lets you down, what actually happens?** Walk me through a recent time it caused a problem or left you unsure about something. Your answer decides what the new setup has to get right first. That might be catching what's missing, making returns easier to record, or showing a picture you can't get from the sheet today.
